description_en: Retrieves the details of a data algorithm service API
description_zh: 调用该接口获取数据算法服务API详情
name: GetDataAPIServiceDetail

parameters.help_en:
The API resource name (ARN), which is the globally unique identifier of the API. This is the ApiSrn value returned after you call the CreateDataAPIService operation to create an API.

Format: `acs:iot:*:${aliyunuserID}:serveapi/${ApiPath}`

Example: `acs:iot:*:127103983461****:serveapi/device/getDeviceCountByStatus2`

The following information describes the fields in the example:

`127103983461****` is the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
`/device/getDeviceCountByStatus` is the value of the ApiPath request parameter, which is the custom part of the API call address
parameters.help_zh:
API资源标识符，API的全局唯一标识。 调用CreateDataAPIService接口成功创建API，返回的ApiSrn值。

格式：`acs:iot:*:${aliyunuserID}:serveapi/${ApiPath}`

示例：`acs:iot:*:127103983461****:serveapi/device/getDeviceCountByStatus2`

以上示例中的信息说明如下：

`127103983461****`是阿里云主账号ID。
`/device/getDeviceCountByStatus`是请求参数ApiPath的值，即API调用地址的自定义部分
